Bullets.Text: Fixed Big Kefka's purple K sometimes appearing on the wrong side during the first Black Hole set in saved pulls. The Analyzer now uses the first hole it sees, so a later turn won't move Kefka on either tether map. This also applies when you reopen an older pull.

If a saved pull or imported FFLogs report is missing the hole's appearance, the Analyzer can use Kefka's facing during Slap Happy. Hover over K to see when that was used. If the evidence conflicts, the marker stays hidden.
Added /foodcheck. It posts No food: and Food expiring soon: in party chat with the names that need attention. Empty groups are skipped, and nothing is posted if everyone is ready.
/foodcheck uses your Food Check warning time. You can adjust it and use the command even when party-list food icons are turned off.
Fixed missing Black Hole tether lines. The map now draws the line to the recorded holder even when the beam applied a debuff without dealing damage.
Players caught in someone else's beam are marked as clipped, not drawn as tether holders. If the holder wasn't recorded, the Analyzer leaves the line out rather than guessing.
Removed the black rectangle behind timers and charge counts in the party list and preview. The bright numbers, thin outline, and font size setting are unchanged.
Fixed Big Kefka's purple K appearing on the wrong side during Black Hole. The marker now locks when each set's holes appear, so a later turn won't move it.
Tether lines still show who actually took each tether, even when it was the wrong player. If the recording doesn't show enough to place Kefka, only the K is hidden.
During Black Hole, the purple K now shows where Big Kefka was at the moment you're watching. It stays on the same wall side until the recording shows him turn, even within a tether set.
During Stomp-a-Mole, Kefka stays on the platform. Each confirmed stomp shows a separate footfall where and when it landed.
Countdown timers and charge counts are easier to read, with brighter numbers on a dark backing.

Added a Font size slider beside Icon size in HUD > Party Cooldowns. Adjust the numbers from 50% to 200% without resizing the icons. Left and right layouts remember their own settings, and the preview shows the result.
Cooldown exports now include both font sizes. Older codes still work and leave your font sizes unchanged.
Party Cooldowns and Food Check indicators now sit behind other Dalamud windows instead of drawing over them. Food Check tooltips no longer appear through a window covering the icon.

Undo last import. Restore the setup you had before importing one job or all jobs, even after restarting Better Deaths. Undo restores your abilities and custom rows. If the import changed your layout, it also restores the active side and each side's icon size, spacing, and position.
Shorter share codes. Exporting every job now produces a much shorter code. Older codes still work; anyone receiving a new code needs v1.0.0.74 or newer.
A bad code or failed save no longer leaves you with a partially changed setup. Your settings and your last undo are preserved.

Failed imports now show an on-screen notice and one red System Message explaining what went wrong. It includes a short code you can share in the Better Deaths channel on the Punish Discord. Successful imports stay out of chat.
Fixed an issue where reloading the plugin could add an unwanted empty first row to a job's custom layout.
Reduced unnecessary work when there are no food warnings to display. Dragging a settings slider now saves once when you finish.
Clarified when food turns amber: with a five-minute warning, 5:00 or less counts as a warning.
Fixed the in-game Updates tab missing the v1.0.0.73 release note about larger cooldown icons.
Increased the maximum cooldown icon size to 1,440 px.
